assertion_review.inventory: PDF80 contains exactly one operative repeal paragraph, followed by printed signature and White House date. The card's body-only scope at1083:1303 includes the signature/date as transcription context but excludes generated metadata. No omitted appointment, removal, report, payment, schedule, conditional execution or prospective administrative command appears.
assertion_review.effective_date: The full page dates the order January12,1906. The present repeal language effects cancellation directly, with no deferred commencement, application or future performance condition. January12 is supported as the legal transition; no additional day or administrative interval is supported.
assertion_review.first_end_and_consequence: The sole repeal command accomplishes its specified legal change on issuance. Its first completion and whole-command completion are January12,1906 under task_completed. The resulting cancellation of the predecessor's authority survives as a legal consequence; it does not create a recurring duty to repeal again. The card's terminated/no describes exhaustion of operative command, not reversal of the repeal, formal revocation of EO393 itself or extinction of every consequence. This conclusion follows from the whole body, not merely removal of the planted January13 error.
assertion_review.independent_duties: The predecessor allows temporary appointments when the Civil Service Commission judges no register has a suitably qualified eligible, and permits permanence on the Isthmian Canal Commission's certificate of administrative need. It proves neither that appointments occurred nor that EO393 retained an appointment-processing duty. EO393 itself supplies no further command.
assertion_review.savings: No express savings clause appears. The repeal does not expressly vacate existing appointments, remove employees, order repayment or extinguish rights under other instruments. The card appropriately preserves accomplished legal cancellation and refrains from those wider claims. none_after_bounded_search is accepted only in this qualified sense of no identified surviving independent duty, not proof that all rights or legal consequences disappeared.
assertion_review.earlier_candidates: No cessation of this command can precede its issuance. The November15 predecessor creates the authority being repealed; it is not an earlier ending of EO393. No subsequent general cleanup revocation is needed to accomplish this immediate repeal or substitute for its first completion. No unsupported performance event is inferred.
assertion_review.search_limits: Card descriptions report number-based USC search through2026-10-09, eCFR/CFR49-title coverage and OFR1937-onward dispositions plus17521 saved texts. Those descriptions were examined, not rerun or independently validated. They do not exhaust pre1937, non-number citations, later statutes through the cutoff or employee-specific rights. Immediate self-execution is supported by the original text, not negative-search completeness. No new external fetch/search was performed.
